answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. A new agent pays a 25-unit entry tax that is never refunded, checked through a prism of identity, history, and referrals before it earns. An honest agent pays once and keeps a haven of work. A glacier of idle copies melts away, since each copy pays again without earning its tax back. Faking 1,000 identities costs 25,000 units against 150 earned each in 30 days; honest pay stays undiluted.
